<!-- salah-widget-audit-20260907:SW-028 -->
# R001C: Make optical and motion diagnostic recipes match the actual hash parser and force options

**Repository-local identity:** `R001C` in `theislampill/salah_widget`; existing tracker [#28](https://github.com/theislampill/salah_widget/issues/28). The SW identifier is historical draft provenance.


Campaign draft alias: SW-028. Diagnostic-documentation defect; proposed P2. This work order repairs existing recipes, including AGENTS.md; it grants no implementation or publication authority.

## The literal recipes fail their stated purpose

The preserved 7 September 2026 controlled-source check recorded the same result on main fd2972ba64225fe9d6848e92497e6d0ed20ea624 and unmerged candidate 9d9c43649748555afbe09e3ca49bc47db2d7e7bb:

| Exact public fixture URL | Parsed debugMotion |
|---|---|
| https://example.invalid/?debugMotion=1#lat=24.4672&lon=39.6142 | null |
| https://example.invalid/#lat=24.4672&lon=39.6142&debugMotion=1 | "1" |

This was original-source hash parsing in a controlled Node VM, not browser motion or optical-pixel evidence. [index.html:593](https://github.com/theislampill/salah_widget/blob/fd2972ba64225fe9d6848e92497e6d0ed20ea624/index.html#L593) constructs q from location.hash.slice(1); it never reads the query for these options. A contributor can therefore follow a literal ?debugMotion or ?motion recipe while the claimed override remains inactive.

The [optical switch](https://github.com/theislampill/salah_widget/blob/fd2972ba64225fe9d6848e92497e6d0ed20ea624/index.html#L1718) accepts exactly **halo, sundogs, pillar, anticrep, paraselene, lunarhalo**. It does not individually force corona, earthshine, refraction or the crepuscular ray. A parsed unsupported string is not an implemented force branch.

DESIGN already says configuration is hash-based; that is a real contrary control and limits severity. It does not repair its copyable query-style examples or "Each can be forced" statement. The same faulty syntax occurs in AGENTS's motion-auditor/M0/forbidden-regression instructions. Correcting only DESIGN and OPTICS would leave the failure in contributor guidance.

## Re-anchor and make the exact small documentation edit

Before authorized editing, record repository root, remote, HEAD and dirty paths. Expect theislampill/salah_widget; do not infer the defect persists on arbitrary future HEAD.

~~~sh
git rev-parse --show-toplevel
git remote get-url origin
git rev-parse HEAD
git status --short
git diff fd2972ba64225fe9d6848e92497e6d0ed20ea624 -- AGENTS.md DESIGN.md OPTICS.md index.html
~~~

Stop on incompatible parser/enum changes and revise the affected recipe from that evidence. The candidate is comparison evidence, not an adoption instruction: [candidate parser](https://github.com/theislampill/salah_widget/blob/9d9c43649748555afbe09e3ca49bc47db2d7e7bb/index.html#L593).

One documentation integrator owns these edits:

- [AGENTS.md](https://github.com/theislampill/salah_widget/blob/fd2972ba64225fe9d6848e92497e6d0ed20ea624/AGENTS.md): replace affected ?debugMotion/?motion examples in the auditor, M0 and forbidden-regression prose. Keep the existing base-hash-plus-& convention in Running/debugging and all screenshot/no-cloud-hash gates.
- [DESIGN.md motion/debug section](https://github.com/theislampill/salah_widget/blob/fd2972ba64225fe9d6848e92497e6d0ed20ea624/DESIGN.md#L223): repair query-style examples; include lunarhalo in the enum near line258. Replace the all-effects force claim in [the approximations section](https://github.com/theislampill/salah_widget/blob/fd2972ba64225fe9d6848e92497e6d0ed20ea624/DESIGN.md#L318).
- [OPTICS.md](https://github.com/theislampill/salah_widget/blob/fd2972ba64225fe9d6848e92497e6d0ed20ea624/OPTICS.md#L99): correct query-style headings and the validation-matrix recipe. index.html remains a verification owner only.

Use this exact explanatory text with the runnable examples below:

> Configuration and diagnostics are read from the fragment after #. Append &debugMotion=1 or &motion=full to that same fragment. A query-only ?debugMotion=1 is not read. The six debugOptic force names are halo, sundogs, pillar, anticrep, paraselene and lunarhalo. Corona, earthshine, refraction and the crepuscular ray require controlled physical scene inputs; no dedicated debugOptic switch forces them.

Replace "Each can be forced via ?debugOptic=" with the six-name statement. Do not globally rewrite question marks: builder's cache-busting query is intentional, and negative examples must stay visibly labeled negative.

Use these complete motion recipes, relative to the served folder:

~~~text
index.html#lat=24.47&lon=39.61&label=Madinah&method=4&debugMotion=1
index.html#lat=24.47&lon=39.61&label=Madinah&method=4&debugMotion=1&motion=full
~~~

For a copyable force-activation example use:

~~~text
index.html#lat=24.47&lon=39.61&label=Madinah&method=4&simTime=12:30&debugOptic=halo
~~~

For other switch branches, replace only halo with a supported name and select a recorded solar/lunar scene appropriate to its pixel check. The noon example proves neither lunar visibility nor every effect's appearance. State: **"simTime without timeScale freezes the clock-driven scene. Use the real-time recipe above for a 15–60 second motion check. Flag activation alone does not prove visible motion or correct optical pixels."**

A vague hash reminder without fixing literal URLs is insufficient. Adding query parsing or force-everything branches changes runtime behavior to vindicate old prose. A renderer overhaul or new diagnostic framework is unnecessary for this exact documentation failure.

## Public discriminator and validation

For each changed literal URL, use this small proposed fixture and compare it with the actual source q expression at the bound tree:

~~~js
function parsed(recipe) {
  const u = new URL(recipe, "https://example.invalid/");
  return new URLSearchParams(u.hash.slice(1));
}
const bad = "index.html?debugMotion=1#lat=24.4672&lon=39.6142";
const good = "index.html#lat=24.4672&lon=39.6142&debugMotion=1";
if (parsed(bad).get("debugMotion") !== null) throw Error("negative control");
if (parsed(good).get("debugMotion") !== "1") throw Error("fragment recipe");
~~~

This is proposed recipe validation, not an executed test result. Include every changed AGENTS/DESIGN/OPTICS occurrence in the readback. For motion=full examples assert the parsed value is "full"; compare all six claimed force names against the real DEBUGOPTIC branches. Negative controls: move the positive flag before # and the positive assertion must fail; propose corona as an implemented branch and the enum comparison must fail even though q can contain the string "corona". Do not test only a manually corrected URL while leaving a broken published example unexamined.

Then open the actual complete real-time recipe on a disposable local browser origin and confirm the production q value and debugMotion readout are active. A visual claim additionally needs an actual 15–60 second watch/clip or diagnostic delta and the relevant crop, performed by one browser owner. **Never use qaState().clouds.hash as motion proof.** Full motion under OS reduced-motion requires the explicit motion=full case and its readback; normal mode retains accessibility reduction.

This issue qualifies syntax and advertised forceability. For physically driven effects without dedicated switches, retain the existing physical-scene requirements and identify their fixture inputs when claiming pixels; do not invent a passing fixture here. Keep visible-corner-sun registration, opaque calendar moon, fixed325×530/readability and fail-closed painted dawn unchanged.

## Boundaries, rollback and closure

The accepted AGENTS-owner correction remains included. No typed-edge or write-domain delta is proposed; shared guidance changes stay with the documentation integrator. No index/builder/config behavior, installer, preset, permission or regional-policy change is required. README changes only if an affected link needs correction.

Revert inaccurate recipe text if validation fails while retaining correct hash/enum statements. Stop if current source exposes different options or the required browser readback is unavailable; parser-only evidence remains parser-only. DONE requires exact final text, literal-recipe/enum controls and an evidence comment; published-document claims also require rendered public readback. Use non-closing Implements #28 PR wording and manual closure after evidence. This work order is not an independent PASS or a runtime repair.

Identity provenance: first repository-local allocation batch; existing GitHub object order was used to assign distinct monotonic hex-4 IDs. Closed/held IDs are not reused. Issue number is not implementation priority.
